item.title: 11 Aug 2026
item.description:
Category: Tragedy | Rating: Sad

item.title: 28 Jul 2026
item.description:
Category: Story | Rating: Upsetting

Had a dream where a friend was mad at me that I lost something (Its something minor, like socks, my own socks) and refused to talk to me until I found them. I was sad and guilty about it at first, but thought its stupid that she did that for something so trivial. I did find it later, and she was close to me again, but at that point I stopped trusting her.

Also theres a part where we entered a school building where the electricity is broken, and had to evacuate while avoiding the sparkling light bulbs.

item.title: 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
Category: Adventure | Rating: Interesting

Had a dream me and many others got stranded on an island, we kinda struggled at first and my flip phone broke (i somehow own a flip phone), but we eventually got along.

I also figured out a way to use commands (like minecraft creative mode) by using a mannequin and a bell. Most commands are locked, but somehow by using a command to make the mannequin ring the bell, I can teleport my allies back to our station or learn their locations.

Apparently at a far corner of the island, there are a few dangerous people, they have cool designs though. That warned me that I shouldn’t use the teleport powers so recklessly, or else I might accidentally teleport them to us.

item.title: 8 Jul 2026
item.description:
Category: Nightmare | Rating: Eugh

I was travelling with my university class in mainland China, but when we were in a clinic, they scanned my face and determined i was a criminal and have a jail sentence of 10 years. I recalled something that might be considered a crime in that dream, but whatever it was, it didn't worth 10 years of jail.

At first, I didn't struggle, defying orders often makes thing worse. However, as I think about it more while being detained, I realised the clinic was somewhat fishy, and I might be innocent afterall... So I sneaked out and went back home (Wow how did the customs not catch me?).

While going back to Hong Kong, I saw some of my classmates and told them about the situation, they said they couldn't find our professor anywhere after that day, and suspected he got abducted by the clinic, oh boy. After I went back to my town, I met Ariel from that Disney Little Mermaid, she comforted me and we sang together. Yea that's the end.

item.title: 16 Jun 2026
item.description:
Category: Casual | Rating: Alright

The first part of the story is me being late to the flight to my grad trip, so instead of going on a bus or any transportation, I decided to fly to the airport because apparently it's the fastest way. However, I did get lost a few times. After I got there, I realised my boyfriend hasn't arrived, so I was panicking.

The second part is me wandering in some sort of park. But midway, I lost my hamster plush, so I went everywhere to find it, but only finding similar looking plushies. Fortunately, I realised the hamster plush is inside my bad. Happy ending!
